notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content: I apologize for not only the time it took to fix this bug, but also for the overall lack of content. As a one man team I am trying my best to work on the game.

notes.title: New Boss
notes.content: Bonedump has been released to Omniblast, he is the newest blue boss. Try beating him classic, boss rush, and multiplayer!

notes.title: Switching to Free to Play
notes.content: Omniblast is going Free to Play on June 1st. This will be followed by more bosses and banners. The decision to go free was made to attract more people to Omniblast, and make it more accessible. The people who have already purchased the game will be compensated with in game currency, but you have to log in before June 1st to claim this reward. BorkoBoks appreciates your continued support, and we hope to have more players soon!
